name: Rapturous
source:
Rapturous is a nsfw furry visual novel/dating sim with  RPG elements. You take the role of a lust demon trying to meet their quota in an impulsive medieval fantasy world.

[From [url=https://zyyphelze.itch.io/rapturous]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Rapturous》是一款含成人内容的兽人视觉小说／恋爱模拟游戏，带有角色扮演元素。你将扮演一名色欲恶魔，在一个冲动而混乱的中世纪奇幻世界中完成配额。

[来源：[url=https://zyyphelze.itch.io/rapturous]Itch.io[/url]]
